glosses.text: n．看守，狱警：负责监视、看管囚犯的人。

collins: A warder is someone who works in a prison supervising the prisoners. 看守

examples.en: Night-jars, sounding their mechanical rattle, made him think that the wood was full of searching warders, closing in on him.
examples.zh: 欧夜鹰发出呆板的嘎嘎声，使他觉得树林里到处都是搜查他的卫兵，正在向他逼近。

examples.en: Not all of our warders were ogres.
examples.zh: 并非所有的狱吏都是妖魔鬼怪。

examples.en: Men like ancient warders, waving halberds;
examples.zh: 有的像古代的卫兵，手里晃着戟；
